ports.note: A source. The output is a keyed table with no geometry and no CRS, which is why it is not the points port: flattening a table to points would mint one point per row and lose the key.

ontology.note: fw:DataTable is declared disjoint from fw:PointDataset, so the distinction the admission review turns on is enforced. CSVW alignment is a recorded candidate and deliberately not claimed. fw:DataTableShape in ontology/shapes/runtime-receipts.ttl constrains the emitted receipt; this registry version records application validation only, so the shape is not referenced in a field.

changes.description: Long-format tabular import with declared key and value columns, an author-stated unit and rejection of duplicate key tuples. Closes the host gap that blocked the sea-level pack; see docs/experiments/48-tabular-input.md.

evidence.note: Unit checks cover the long-format contract, duplicate key rejection, missing values retained and counted, stated and unstated units, absent columns and the row cap. The importer checks shape and identity, not whether a table's units or values are correct.
